sloka: पात्रीणां च सहस्राणि स्थालीनां नियुतानि च ।न्यर्बुदानि च पात्राणि शातकुम्भमयानि च ॥ २.९१.७०॥
transliteration: pātrīṇāṁ ca sahasrāṇi sthālīnāṁ niyutāni ca ।nyarbudāni ca pātrāṇi śātakumbhamayāni ca ॥ 2.91.70॥

translations.english: Along the edge of the forest, wells were filled with thick payasam. There were wishfulfilling cows and honeydripping trees.
